definition_zh: 抵制；拒绝购买或参与；联合排拒
definition_en: to refuse to buy, use, or take part in something as a protest
core_image: 一群人背对一家店铺站成一排，双手抱臂，谁也不进店门
scene: 物价上涨后居民们商量对策。The townspeople agreed to boycott the grain merchant until prices fell.
sceneCN: 这里 boycott 是「拒绝购买以示抗议」（第 1 个义项：联合拒买拒往）；句意是镇民约定抵制粮商，直到价格回落。

derivatives.zh: 由动词加表人后缀构成，义为「抵制者」
由动词加形容词后缀构成，义为「抵制性的」（罕用）

senses.title: To refuse to buy from or deal with someone
senses.titleCN: 拒买拒往；与某人断绝交易
senses.definition: to refuse to buy goods from or do business with a person or company as a protest
senses.definitionCN: 出于抗议而拒绝购买某人或某公司的商品、拒绝与其交易
senses.example: Customers boycotted the store over its labor practices.
senses.exampleCN: 顾客因该店的用工做法而抵制其店铺。
senses.why: The original act was exactly this: tenants refusing all dealings with Captain Boycott.
senses.whyCN: 词源事件正是这一动作：佃农拒与博伊特上尉发生一切往来。

senses.title: To refuse to take part in an event
senses.definition: to stay away from a meeting, election, or event in protest
senses.definitionCN: 以抗议为由不出席会议、选举或活动
senses.example: Three parties boycotted the parliamentary vote.
senses.exampleCN: 三个政党抵制了议会投票。
senses.why: Withholding purchase widens to withholding presence; abstention is the same weapon in another room.
senses.whyCN: 拒绝购买扩大为拒绝出席，「弃权不至」是同一武器在另一场合的使用。

senses.title: To refuse to use or perform
senses.definition: to refuse to use a service, product, or perform a duty as pressure
senses.definitionCN: 以施压为目的拒绝使用某服务、产品或拒绝履行职责
senses.example: Drivers boycotted the new toll road for a month.
senses.exampleCN: 司机们抵制新收费公路达一个月之久。
senses.why: If not buying is protest, so is not using; the refusal simply changes object.
senses.whyCN: 不买是抗议，不用同样是抗议，只是拒绝的对象变了。

senses.title: To shun socially
senses.definition: to keep away from a person socially, refusing contact
senses.definitionCN: 在社交上回避某人，拒绝往来
senses.example: The community boycotted the landlord at every gathering.
senses.exampleCN: 社区在一切聚会上都对那位地主避而不见。
senses.why: The Irish original was as much social isolation as economic pressure.
senses.whyCN: 爱尔兰原初事件中，社交孤立与经济施压本就一体。

senses.title: A coordinated refusal by many
senses.definition: an organized campaign of refusal to buy or take part
senses.definitionCN: 有组织的拒绝购买或参与的行动
senses.example: The boycott lasted until fares were cut.
senses.exampleCN: 抵制行动持续到票价下调才结束。
senses.why: The verb names one act; the noun names the campaign made of many such acts.
senses.whyCN: 动词指单次行为，名词指由众多同类行为构成的运动。

senses.title: An official or legal ban on trade
senses.definition: a formal prohibition on trade or contact imposed by authorities
senses.definitionCN: 由官方施加的贸易或往来禁令
senses.example: The league announced a boycott of the country's goods.
senses.exampleCN: 联盟宣布抵制该国的商品。
senses.why: When many individuals act together formally, the refusal hardens into an instrument of policy.
senses.whyCN: 当众多个体的拒绝行为正式联合起来，拒斥就固化为政策工具。

senses.title: To withhold cooperation in negotiation
senses.definition: to refuse to cooperate or engage in a process as leverage
senses.definitionCN: 以拒绝合作或参与进程作为谈判筹码
senses.example: The union boycotted the talks until safety was on the agenda.
senses.exampleCN: 工会拒绝参加谈判，直到安全问题列入议程。
senses.why: Withdrawal of presence is leverage; the sense extends the weapon from shops to conferences.
senses.whyCN: 退出本身就是筹码；这一武器由店铺延伸到谈判桌。

senses.title: To reject something in judgment
senses.definition: to reject an idea, prize, or opportunity on principle
senses.definitionCN: 出于原则拒受奖项、机会或主张
senses.example: Several authors boycotted the literary prize in protest.
senses.exampleCN: 几位作家为抗议而拒受该文学奖。
senses.why: Refusing goods, rooms, and talks finally shades into refusing honors themselves.
senses.whyCN: 拒商品、拒会场、拒会谈之后，最终连荣誉本身也可以拒。

intro.en: Boycott is a rare word born from one man's name: Captain Charles Boycott, an Irish land agent shunned in 1880.
intro.cn: boycott 是罕见地由一人之名诞生的词：1880 年遭集体排拒的爱尔兰土地经纪人博伊特上尉。

items.en: Boycott is an English surname, probably from a place name in England; its earlier origin is uncertain.
items.cn: Boycott 是英语姓氏，一般认为源于英格兰地名，更早来源不确定。

items.en: Captain Charles Cunningham Boycott managed estates in County Mayo; tenants, led by the Land League, refused all dealings with him.
items.cn: 博伊特上尉在梅奥郡管理地产；佃农在土地同盟领导下拒绝与他发生一切往来。

items.en: Newspapers covering the affair turned the name into a verb within weeks, and boycott was born.
items.cn: 报道该事件的报纸数周内就把这个人名变成了动词，boycott 由此诞生。

items.en: The word was quickly borrowed into French, German, Russian, and many other languages, a rare full eponym.
items.cn: 该词迅速进入法语、德语、俄语等众多语言，是少有的完全人名来源词。

items.en: The noun sense settled as the campaign form, extending from trade to elections and culture.
items.cn: 名词义定型为行动形式，适用范围从贸易扩展到选举与文化领域。

items.en: Modern English uses boycott freely for consumer, political, and social refusal alike.
items.cn: 现代英语中 boycott 泛用于消费、政治、社会各领域的拒斥行为。

note.en: Boycott has no spelling twins; its near group is the family of protest refusals.
note.cn: boycott 没有拼写近似词；近义组是各种「抗议性拒绝」。

entries.definition: a person who joins a boycott
entries.definitionCN: 抵制者；动词加表人后缀
有浮力的；轻快的；与 boycott 仅拼写相近，词源不同
政变；音近形异，词源不同
官方贸易禁令；自上而下，boycott 多为民间发起

entries.definition: an official penalty, often on trade
entries.definitionCN: 官方制裁；boycott 强调拒绝参与而非惩罚

entries.definition: a list of people to be shunned
entries.definitionCN: 黑名单；抵制常以名单形式执行
罢工；同属「拒绝参与」型抗议
刻意回避；个体行为，boycott 强调集体性

normalIntro.en: Remember the man: boycott is literally Captain Boycott's name turned into everyone's weapon.
normalIntro.cn: 记住那个人：boycott 就是把博伊特上尉的姓变成了众人的武器。

normal.en: Captain Boycott managed an estate in Ireland in 1880.
normal.cn: 1880 年，博伊特上尉在爱尔兰管理庄园。

normal.en: his tenants refused all dealings; newspapers named the act after him.
normal.cn: 佃农拒绝一切往来；报纸便以他之名命名这一行为。

normal.en: -cott is just part of the surname; there is no separate root.
normal.cn: -cott 只是姓氏的一部分，并无独立词根。

normal.en: the verb came first; the noun followed immediately.
normal.cn: 动词先出现，名词紧随其后。

normal.en: the word crossed into dozens of languages within years.
normal.cn: 短短数年间该词进入数十种语言。

abstract.en: Picture a circle of turned backs around one shop door.
abstract.cn: 想象一圈背对着一家店门的身影。

abstract.en: Empty purses are the loudest protest speech.
abstract.cn: 空钱袋是最响亮的抗议演说。

abstract.en: One man gave his name; the crowd gave the word its meaning.

examples.en: Consumers boycotted the brand until it recalled the faulty product.
examples.cn: 消费者抵制该品牌，直到它召回了问题产品。

examples.en: The players threatened a boycott of the tournament over prize money.
examples.cn: 运动员们因奖金问题威胁抵制该赛事。

examples.en: A worldwide boycott of whaling products changed policy within a decade.
examples.cn: 全球范围的捕鲸产品抵制在十年内改变了政策。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「不一一卡特」——不买、不去、不谈，一样（一）一样地拒（卡特如「cut」切掉）：把对方从你的名单上一刀刀切掉。

root: 非词根词：源自人名 Boycott（英语姓氏，一般认为出自英格兰地名，更早来源不确定）；1880 年爱尔兰佃农集体拒与土地经纪人博伊特上尉往来，其姓由此转为普通名词。

sensesIntro.en: From refusing to trade, the senses spread to staying away, refusing to use, social shunning, and finally to the organized campaign itself.
sensesIntro.cn: 义项从拒绝交易出发，扩展到拒不出席、拒绝使用、社交排拒，最终落到有组织的抵制行动本身。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a community closing its doors and purses against one name
core.cn: 核心意象：一个社区对某个名字关门闭户、捂紧钱袋

branches.en: money withheld: no buying, no using
presence withheld: empty seats as leverage
branches.cn: 抽身而去：空座位即筹码

branches.en: doors closed socially: the shunned neighbor
branches.cn: 社交闭门：被回避的邻居

branches.en: many refusals organized into a campaign or ban
branches.cn: 众拒成势：联合行动与官方禁令

branches.en: the final refusal: rejecting honors themselves
branches.cn: 最后的拒绝：连荣誉也拒受

intro.en: As an eponym, boycott has no prefix or root; its structure is a proper name plus a verb pattern.
intro.cn: 作为人名转化词，boycott 没有前缀或词根；其结构只是专名套入动词模式。

latinIntro.en: No Latin cognates exist; the word's history is documentary, not etymological.
latinIntro.cn: 没有拉丁同源词；这个词的历史是文献史，而非词源学史。

items.meaning: an English surname, probably from a place name
items.meaningCN: 英语姓氏，一般认为源于地名

items.example: boyc- cannot be separated as a root

items.exampleCN: 过去式与现在分词均为双写 t
strike 与 boycott 同属拒斥逻辑

items.example: shun is the individual act behind the campaign
items.exampleCN: shun 是行动背后的个体动作
